headline: Sensex and Nifty Jump Over 500 Points as Crude Oil Prices Ease and Rupee Strengthens

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices eased, reducing inflationary concerns for the Indian economy
Easing tensions in West Asia improved global investor sentiment and risk appetite
The Indian Rupee appreciated by 15 paise against the U.S. dollar to close at 95.81
Strong cues from international markets including Gift Nifty and Asian indices like Nikkei and Kospi
whatHappening: Sensex closed 564 points higher, while Nifty ended the session above the 23,400 level
Oriental Aromatics and Bodal Chemicals hit 52-week highs following a month-long rally of up to 150%
Mumbai and Thane petrol dealers threatened to stop UPI payments from October 15 over new MDR charges
India and Canada are scheduled to resume negotiations for a proposed trade pact starting October 5
summary: Indian markets rallied significantly with the Sensex gaining 564 points, supported by falling crude oil prices and a stronger Rupee. Commodity stocks like Oriental Aromatics and Bodal Chemicals reached 52-week highs as investor confidence improved. Despite geopolitical tensions, domestic indices remained resilient, closing well above key psychological levels.
